description: Both BPF parameters persisted, deliberately across two different sources: the caller half in /etc/sysctl.conf and the JIT half in a drop-in. It proves the collector merges the sources rather than reading one of them, and that the finding cites the file and line each value actually came from. Nothing here disagrees with anything, so there is no precedence question to answer — which is the only shape in which precedence can be demonstrated without ambiguity. See kernel-bpf-conflict for the shape where it cannot.
